VI.description: The plain-VI half of the mixed rig. Its pane carries three of the variants at once\3A Limits is a typedef holding another typedef\2C Samples is an ARRAY whose element is a typedef\2C and Reading is a PLAIN typedef. Every terminal is authored as its bare underlying type and then bound with {LV.Control} Replace.
